MODERN DOG GROOMING

Goose & Co
Because Dogs Deserve Better

Thoughtful, skin-focused grooming for dogs who need a little extra care. 

Goose & Co. is a modern dog grooming studio for dogs who deserve better and people who care a lot about them.

Grooming should be calm, thoughtful, and actually enjoyable (yes, really). No rushing, no chaos, just gentle handling, happy dogs, and a space that feels good to walk into.

We’re here to do grooming a little differently in our neighborhood — slower, kinder, and with way more heart. Because dogs deserve better… and honestly, so do their people.

Every detail in our studio is chosen with your dog in mind — from calming scents and soft lighting to sound and visuals designed to help dogs feel at ease.

It’s a space built to feel gentle, familiar, and low-stress because small details make a big difference.
BOOK AN APPOINTMENT
Where Grooming BeginsWith the Skin.

AT GOOSE & CO, GROOMING SHOULD FEEL CALM, THOUGHTFUL, AND DEEPLY INTENTIONAL.

Grooming at Goose & Co. is calm, unhurried, and tailored to your dog, not a conveyor belt, not a guessing game.

Every appointment begins with a gentle skin and coat evaluation. We look at texture, dryness, sensitivities, and overall coat health before selecting products or beginning any service.

There is no rushing, no one-size-fits-all baths, and no unnecessary stress. Just careful handling, customized product selection, and an environment designed to help dogs feel safe.

Because when dogs feel comfortable, everything looks better too.

Skin & Coat Wellness Is
Our Specialty
At Goose & Co, grooming begins with the skin.

We see so many dogs struggling with seasonal allergies, dryness, irritation, dull coats, excessive shedding, or simply discomfort that goes unnoticed. Sometimes it’s subtle. Sometimes it’s obvious. Either way, it deserves attention.

Each dog is thoughtfully evaluated before we begin. Coat condition, sensitivities, lifestyle, and past reactions guide how we approach every appointment. We use professional products and tailor every formula to your dog’s unique needs.

NO ONE-SIZE-FITS-ALL BATHS. NO RUSHING THROUGH.

Just customized, skin-focused care designed to help your dog feel as good as they look.

This focus is personal to us. Goose herself has struggled with allergies and that journey shaped how we care for every dog who walks through our doors.

EXPLORE SKIN & COAT WELLNESS
The good stuff we do, with a lot of heart
SERVICES
Full Groom

A head-to-paw refresh designed around your dog’s unique coat and personality.

Includes a gentle, skin-aware bath with customized product selection, haircut, fluff, tidy, and finishing touches. Whether they’re teddy-bear chic or sleek and polished, we sculpt with comfort and care in mind.

Because looking good should feel good, too.

Bath & Blowout

Your pup’s signature cloud moment.

A warm, thoughtful cleanse using professional products selected for your dog’s specific skin needs, followed by a full fluff-out and light finishing. Perfect between haircuts or anytime your dog needs a reset.

Fresh. Soft. Extremely huggable.

Puppy & First-Timers

Tiny paws. Big feelings.

This gentle introduction to grooming is all about confidence-building, positive exposure, and small wins. We move slowly, celebrate progress, and help your pup learn that grooming can be safe (and maybe even kind of fun).

Trust first. Beauty second.

Skin & Coat Wellness

For dogs who need a little extra attention and a lot of intention.

From seasonal allergies and dryness to coat imbalance or excessive shedding, we begin with a thoughtful evaluation and tailor every product and step to your dog’s unique skin needs.

No one-size-fits-all baths.

No rushing through.

Just personalized, skin-focused care designed to help your dog feel comfortable in their own coat.

VIEW ALL SERVICES
Here, Kitty Kitty
(…yes, we groom cats too)

We’re a dog-first kind of place, but we’ve got a soft spot (and a very skilled team) for cats.

Cat grooming at Goose & Co. is handled by groomers who understand feline behavior, coat care, and how to keep things as calm and efficient as possible because let’s be honest, cats are not here for the spa day.

From de-shedding and sanitary trims to full lion cuts and mat removal, every appointment is approached with patience, respect, and a plan.

CAT GROOMING IS AVAILABLE WITH SELECT GROOMERS AND MUST BE REQUESTED IN ADVANCE.

Think: a pop of color on the ears, a tinted tail, or something a little more custom if you’re feeling bold.

Available as an add-on or custom request with select groomers.

Thank you for considering our grooming services for your senior dog. We deeply care about the well-being of all the dogs in our care, and for senior dogs, we take extra precautions to ensure their safety and comfort throughout the grooming process.

Due to the additional time, attention, and specialized care required for senior dogs, especially those with health concerns, we have reached our capacity for accepting more senior dogs at this time.

3) For old senior dogs over age of 10, and those with special health concerns, we may require owner to stay in the store until grooming is complete. If your dog has special health issues, we recommend that grooming be done only with the vet's permission.

a certified professional groomer from Hong Kong. After 5 years working from my home based grooming salon, in Dec 2018, I decided to expand to a friendly neighborhood to provide dog grooming services. BOOK A TRIAL DAY

Free trial days available Mon & Fri, 9am-12pm. For small dogs under 30 lbs.

Why Small Dogs Need Their Own Space

Without big-dog energy around, small dogs can play safely in a space made for their size and comfort. Their social style is gentler and more intimate, which is why we create small, thoughtfully matched play groups. And with a calm, cozy environment, dogs feel less stressed, more confident, and truly at ease.

is sunshine right for your dog?

Great fit for:

Small dogs under 30 lbs
Our space is designed specifically for smaller pups to feel safe, comfortable, and confident.

Dogs with current vaccinations
For everyone’s safety, we require current Rabies, DHPP, and Bordetella vaccinations.

Dogs who could use more stimulation
Long days at home can be lonely. Our mix of play, puzzles, and sniff work keeps your little one engaged from drop-off to pick-up.

Services we offer
Daycare

Our daycare provides a safe, structured environment where small dogs under 30 lbs can play, socialize, and rest at their own pace. Pups are grouped thoughtfully by size and play style, with constant supervision and plenty of time for both activity and relaxation.

EXPLORE PACKAGES
Grooming

We offer bathing and grooming services for dogs up to 50 lbs, using high-quality, pet-safe products. Whether your pup needs a simple refresh or a full grooming session, our team focuses on comfort, careful handling, and a calm experience from start to finish.

BOOK GROOMING
What a Day at Sunshine Looks Like

Mornings start with open play and socialization. For new pups, this is all about getting comfortable with the pack at their own pace. Once everyone is settled in, our team sets up enrichment activities tailored to each dog's personality, from puzzle feeders and agility courses to simple confidence-building tricks. Every program is designed with their mental wellbeing in mind, helping each pup grow a little more confident every day.

Midday is reserved for lunch and a well-deserved nap break.

In the afternoon, we make sure every pup is well-rested before easing into a calm enrichment session and a final round of free play with friends. We then wind down the day slowly and gently, so every pup is happy and relaxed by the time their pet parent arrives for pickup.

For pups who feel most comfortable going potty outdoors, we offer relief breaks on clean grass in a safe area right near our facility. Just mention it at drop-off and we will make sure your little one gets their outdoor time!

Our care philosophy

We built Sunshine because we know how it feels to leave your dog in someone else’s care.

Every detail, from how we group dogs to how we greet them in the morning, is designed with intention.

We keep things calm, clean, and thoughtfully structured. We pay attention to the little things, like who needs a break, who prefers a quiet corner, and who just wants a little extra love.

No overwhelm. No big-dog energy. No shortcuts.

Just a safe, happy space where small dogs can be themselves, and where you can feel completely at ease leaving them with us.

Comprehensive Grooming Packages

We offer three tailored grooming packages to suit your pet’s needs: Bath, Grooming, and V.I.P. Each package includes:

Bath Package

Perfect for pets needing a quick refresh, this package includes a gentle bath, nail trimming, ear cleaning, anal gland expression (if needed), eye wash, a hand blow dry, and a complete brush-out. Ideal for pets in Vallejo or Fairfield who need regular maintenance.

Grooming Package

This all-inclusive option builds on the Bath Package with a customized haircut tailored to your pet’s breed, coat type, or your preferences. Our skilled groomers use precision techniques to ensure a polished look, whether it’s a classic trim for a Golden Retriever in Oakland or a stylish cut for a Poodle in Piedmont.

V.I.P. Package

Our certified groomer greets your pet, confirms the requested service, and provides gentle, one-on-one grooming.

Comprehensive Grooming Packages

We offer three tailored grooming packages to suit your pet’s needs: Bath, Grooming, and V.I.P. Each package includes:

Bath Package

Perfect for pets needing a quick refresh, this package includes a gentle bath, nail trimming, ear cleaning, anal gland expression (if needed), eye wash, a hand blow dry, and a complete brush-out. Ideal for pets in Vallejo or Fairfield who need regular maintenance.

Learn More
Grooming Package

This all-inclusive option builds on the Bath Package with a customized haircut tailored to your pet’s breed, coat type, or your preferences. Our skilled groomers use precision techniques to ensure a polished look, whether it’s a classic trim for a Golden Retriever in Oakland or a stylish cut for a Poodle in Piedmont.

Learn More
V.I.P. Package

For pets deserving extra pampering, our V.I.P. Package elevates the grooming experience with premium add-ons.

How It Works

and Convenient—Every Time

About Us

Bark Avenue Methods & Philosophy

In interactions with our dogs, Bark Avenue employees use only positive reinforcement dog training methods, based on canine behavioral science. We use natural dog motivators like toys, treats, praise, and attention to elicit the desired behavior. Dogs are never subjected to punishment, threats, yelling, or aversive techniques involving leashes or collars.

Meet the Owner
Craig Cucinella

Owner
craig@barkavesf.com

Craig Cucinella is a lifelong animal lover and dog owner, with over 25 years working in hospitality, operations and management all over the country and world. He started working with dogs while growing up in the midwest as a dog walker and veterinary assistant – and for most of the last 20 years has been a regular with his own pups at the dog parks and grassy fields in the Mission Bay neighborhood.

 

Personalized care, positive reinforcement, and a playful and supportive environment are the focal points of what Bark Avenue is all about, and Craig is committed to continuing this philosophy and building on the sense of community the team and customers at Bark Avenue have created.

Founder

Amanda Rotondo is the founder and former COO of Bark Avenue Doggy Day Care, a trusted cornerstone of San Francisco’s Mission Bay community for over 13 years. Built on a foundation of compassion, her love of dogs, and operational excellence, Bark Avenue became known for its personalized pet care, force-free training methods, and unwavering commitment to safety and service. With certifications in dog training and pet first aid, Amanda ensured all practices reflected evidence-based, humane standards. Beyond her hands-on care approach, she oversaw HR strategy, daily operations, and client relationships—establishing Bark Avenue as a leader in the competitive pet care industry. After selling the business in 2025, Amanda continues to champion ethical, innovative approaches to strengthening the human-animal bond.

Dan Perata is a San Francisco original, someone who has always bucked the traditional conventional wisdom. A third-generation native of the city, Dan has always had a natural rapport with all animals, and dogs in particular, and he’s been working with them since he was a teen. He’s been honing and perfecting his methods ever since, sometimes in the most fascinating of places.

Puppy Preschool 101 (Puppy Kindergarten) & Kindergarten 201 group classes plus 1:1 Puppy Head Start.

Dog Daycare San Francisco

Small dog daycare (under 25 lbs) in the Sunset — supervised socialization, enrichment, and rest.

Off-Leash Dog Ranch, Bay Area

Adventure Outings at our private off-leash dog ranch — a safer alternative to crowded off-leash dog parks.

Private Dog Trainer SF

In-home, force-free, reward-based dog training with CPDT-KA certified trainers.

Group Dog Training Classes SF
